changelog: Targets patched Jellyfin 12.4 (plugin ABI 12.4.0.0). The core overlay is rebased onto release-12.z, including the HLS remux audio preroll fix. Library listings report which items have a sidecar. Rebuild the patched server.
description: Applies sidecar .corr.json edits during playback on patched Jellyfin. Per-user apply toggle, category filters, and optional per-edit spoken language.
